w: Swamishri, senior sadhus and 200 devotees participated in the first inauguration anniversary of the shikharbaddh mandir in Nadiad. In his blessings Swamishri said, "... The murti pratishtha was performed today last year, and we need to be reminded of it because we tend to forget due to the daily grind of work and social duties. We need to be afresh in matters of devotion, spiritual discourses and service to God... Shriji Maharaj tells us to be ever fresh in this matter because it blesses us with moksha." In the evening Swamishri attended the Chhatralay’s annual day programs. The student residents of the hostel performed a drama with respect to the influence of bad company. In his blessings Swamishri said, "... Fifty years ago , Yogiji Maharaj established with great foresight, youth forums and children’s forums to nourish academic consciousness and Satsang values in them. "In the drama, we saw the effect of bad company and good company on a child. Today we find there are so many powerful attractions like T.V. Even in college we see so many attractions and students get entrapped in them. But we have to understand that they are not good. We have to preserve our character and study. And that is why we should keep good company..."
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha at the two new BAPS Swaminarayan Sanskardhams in Hiravadi and Bapunagar (suburbs of Amdavad). Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Swamishri flew from Sydney to Auckland, arriving at 10.40 pm local time.
Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the deities for the BAPS hari mandir in the town of Kalol. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the devotees by showering rice grains.

At 9.50 am Swamishri arrived from Atladra at Bodeli to perform the foundation-stone laying ceremony for the shikharbaddh BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir. The Vedic rituals of the ceremony had already commenced. Five thousand tribal devotees and wellwishers were participating in the mahapuja rituals. The railway minister Shri Narayansinh Rathwa and ex-forest minister Shri Mohansinh Rathwa, district president Shri Ranjitsinh Rathwa and other officials were also present at the stone-laying ceremony. Swamishri performed the rituals on the main foundation stone by pouring panchamrut and doing pujan. Senior sadhus, Pujya Dr Swami, Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami, performed the rituals on other foundation stones. After Swamishri had poured cement into the foundation he attended the satsang assembly. Pujya Viveksagar Swami, Pujya Dr Swami and Pujya Divyaswarup Swami addressed the assembly of 5,000 tribal devotees. Narayansinh Rathwa praised the services of BAPS, saying, “You are all fortunate because your need for many years has been fulfilled today. I have seen that before satsang there was nothing here. People were in the vice-grip of superstitions and bad practices. Then with the increasing grace of Swaminarayan people changed and became pious. Formerly, it was not possible to travel by night, but now after satsang there is no fear.” Finally, Swamishri addressed the assembly, “Due to satsang people have been transformed. After understanding that addictions impoverish oneself it does not take long in giving them up. Bhagwan Swaminarayan gave two principles – one of moral living and the other of an addiction-free life. Moral living means not to mete out misery and pain on others. One should live properly and let others do so too… Our body requires food for sustenance. But when you realise your atma you will find that its means of sustenance lies in devotion, satsang, spiritual knowledge and morality. By engaging in bhajan and kirtan of God the atma becomes stronger... One should not eat meat for food. Never live by killing. Let us live and also let live.” At 11.15 am Swamishri departed from the assembly and thereafter the devotees placed one brick each in the foundation pit. Twenty thousand devotees were served lunch.

This morning the President rang to enquire about Swamishri’s health. During the 11 minute conversation he asked about Swamishri’s health and informed that he had done two malas and prayed to God for Swamishri’s good health.

Swamishri replied to the President, “Your prayers to God for me reflect your love and feelings. I too always pray for your good health and that God does good works through you. There is another thing I would like to say and that is the body becomes ill and well. It is through God’s will that the body gets ill or well, but I ask you to always pray that with this body may I be able to do good deeds.” President: “Swamiji, you have done the greatest good for our nation. No one person has been able to unite so many minds, so much energy to create something like Akshardham. It is Swamiji, your greatest contribution to our nation, to human civilization.”

Swamishri: “It was done through God’s wish. It was done through the grace of Yogiji Maharaj and God. You are also pious and have faith in God, so may good works be done through you for our nation. Such works will be done by you that people will be happy and you too will have inner happiness.” President: “Swamiji, Maha Pramukhji, you know I too remember you almost everyday. How? Not one day passes without someone coming to me and praising Akshardham. You have created the heritage of our civilization. Daily thousands visit Akshardham from our country and other countries. They all feel proud to be Indian and come out as fine human beings. You know not just me, the whole nation prays for you when you are ill. You will always be well because Akshardham constantly prays for you, all visitors pray for you. Also pray for me that I continue my little work of correcting things, of setting things right.” At 8.10 pm the same day the President rang again to enquire about Swamishri’s health report. The President was told that the report would arrive on Monday. Then the President told Swamishri, “Maha Pramukhji, I know everything will be fine. There will be no problem. God will take care of you as he always does.” Swamishri thanked the President for his care and concern and once again said that he would pray for his good health and continuing good works that he is doing. Then the President added, “Tell me Swamiji, when Swaminarayan is with you, who can be against you!”
Swamishri acknowledged the President’s care and love for him.
Today, current affairs were being discussed before Pramukh Swami Maharaj. As some bitter truths about social and national problems came up, someone said, "This country is not worth living in."
Swamishri stopped him and said, "But why should we leave and go?"
"Well, wherever you go there are just as many problems, so this whole world is not worth living in."
Giving a completely new outlook, Swamishri said, "But where are we living in the world? We are outside it! If we have the vision of knowledge, then even while in the world, we are outside it."
Swamishri simply explained the key to staying happy in every situation, by wearing the armour of spiritual knowledge.

A murti of Shastriji Maharaj was consecrated in the hari mandir at Dadar mandir. The preliminary murti-pratishtha rituals were performed by Kothari Swami. Finally, Swamishri performed the pujan rituals. Then the study books used by Shastriji Maharaj were brought for darshan. Finally, Kothari Swami and Viveksagar Swami garlanded Swamishri to commemorate the occasion.

ds.t: The love of the embodiment of love
w: When they learned that Swamishri was unwell, thousands of youths in India and abroad began prayers, austerities and vows. Some even prayed in letters, 'O Lord! Give us Pramukh Swami Maharaj's illness.'
Some loving youths also prayed for Swamishri's health over the phone. Today, when a call came from one such student in America, Swamishri asked him, "Your studies are going well, aren't they?"
"I am trying," he said.

Swamishri said, "Not trying. Study properly. Your father has expanded his business, and you will have to look after it later! And take care that no addiction or vice gets in and no bad company touches you. However much friends pressure or insist, do not take anything. Keep going to satsang regularly and study well. These are my blessings."
Bathing in this Ganga of Swamishri's love, the teenager living thousands of miles away felt blessed.
A police inspector came for darshan. He said, "I do my work, but many wrong thoughts come."
Swamishri said, "Remember God while you work, and wrong thoughts will not come."
